query:
SELECT clienteNome, COUNT(*) as total, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY createdAt) as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(createdAt ORDER BY createdAt) as datas
FROM vendas
WHERE cancelada = 0
GROUP BY clienteNome
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY total DESC;
